```{python}
#| label: thin_market_filter

from pygam import LinearGAM, s
from functools import reduce
import operator
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Thin Market Exploration — Spline-Based Filtering
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Before splitting the data we use a preliminary GAM fit on the full dataset
# to identify where spline relationships break down (thin market segments).
# Properties in these regions exhibit fundamentally different pricing dynamics
# and are excluded prior to modeling.

SPLINE_COLS    = ["ln_GLA", "EffYearBuilt_Weighted", "Quality_Weighted",
                  "AsinH_Acreage", "AsinH_Land_Value", "AsinH_Total_Value"]
NUMERIC_COLS   = [c for c in df_copy.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
                  if c != "ln_Trended_Price" and c not in SPLINE_COLS]

# ── Fit a quick preliminary GAM on the full cleaned dataset ───────────────────
X_explore = df_copy[SPLINE_COLS].fillna(0).values
y_explore  = df_copy["ln_Trended_Price"].values

spline_idx    = list(range(len(SPLINE_COLS)))
gam_terms     = reduce(operator.add, [s(i, n_splines=20) for i in spline_idx])
gam_explore   = LinearGAM(gam_terms)
gam_explore.gridsearch(X_explore, y_explore, lam=np.logspace(0, 8, 60), progress=False)

print(f"Exploratory GAM fit complete")
print(f"  Best lambda : {np.unique([round(float(l[0]), 4) for l in gam_explore.lam])}")
print(f"  GCV Score   : {gam_explore.statistics_['GCV']:.6f}")

# ── Plot splines to identify thin market inflection points ────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(SPLINE_COLS), figsize=(5 * len(SPLINE_COLS), 4))
for i, col in enumerate(SPLINE_COLS):
    XX = gam_explore.generate_X_grid(term=i)
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_explore.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX), color="#2980b9")
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_explore.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX, width=0.95)[1],
                 c="r", ls="--", alpha=0.5)
    axes[i].axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle=":", alpha=0.5)
    axes[i].set_title(f"Spline: {col}")
    axes[i].set_xlabel(col)
    axes[i].set_ylabel("Partial Effect on ln(Price)")
plt.suptitle("Exploratory GAM — Spline Partial Effects (Pre-Split, Full Data)", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Percentile summary to inform cutoff decisions ─────────────────────────────
print("\nln_GLA distribution:")
for p in [90, 95, 99]:
    print(f"  {p}th percentile: {np.percentile(df_copy['ln_GLA'], p):.3f}  "
          f"(GLA ≈ {np.exp(np.percentile(df_copy['ln_GLA'], p)):.0f} sqft)")

print("\nAsinH_Acreage distribution:")
for p in [90, 95, 99]:
    print(f"  {p}th percentile: {np.percentile(df_copy['AsinH_Acreage'], p):.3f}  "
          f"(Acreage ≈ {np.sinh(np.percentile(df_copy['AsinH_Acreage'], p)):.2f} acres)")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Apply Thin Market Filter
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Filters applied only where splines show a clear terminal decline,
# indicating thin market segments with fundamentally different pricing dynamics.
#
#   ln_GLA          — peaks ~8.0, sharp decline after
#   Quality_Weighted — peaks ~5.5, sharp decline after  
#   AsinH_Land_Value — peaks ~12.5, sharp decline after
#   AsinH_Total_Value — peaks ~14.5, sharp decline after
#
# No filter applied to EffYearBuilt_Weighted or AsinH_Acreage as neither
# shows a sustained terminal decline.

rows_before = len(df_copy)

GLA_UPPER         = 8.0    # ln scale  → np.exp(8.0)  ≈ 2,981 sqft
QUALITY_UPPER     = 5.5    # raw scale
LAND_VAL_UPPER    = 12.5   # arcsinh scale → np.sinh(12.5) ≈ $134,561
TOTAL_VAL_UPPER   = 14.5   # arcsinh scale → np.sinh(14.5) ≈ $996,332

df_copy = df_copy[
    (df_copy['ln_GLA']            <= GLA_UPPER)       &
    (df_copy['Quality_Weighted']  <= QUALITY_UPPER)   &
    (df_copy['AsinH_Land_Value']  <= LAND_VAL_UPPER)  &
    (df_copy['AsinH_Total_Value'] <= TOTAL_VAL_UPPER)
]

rows_after = len(df_copy)

print(f"Thin Market Filters Applied:")
print(f"  ln_GLA          ≤ {GLA_UPPER}   → GLA          ≈ {np.exp(GLA_UPPER):>10,.0f} sqft")
print(f"  Quality_Weighted ≤ {QUALITY_UPPER}   → Quality cap  ≈ {QUALITY_UPPER:>10.1f}")
print(f"  AsinH_Land_Value ≤ {LAND_VAL_UPPER}  → Land Value   ≈ ${np.sinh(LAND_VAL_UPPER):>10,.0f}")
print(f"  AsinH_Total_Value ≤ {TOTAL_VAL_UPPER}  → Total Value  ≈ ${np.sinh(TOTAL_VAL_UPPER):>10,.0f}")
print(f"\n  Rows before  : {rows_before}")
print(f"  Rows after   : {rows_after}")
print(f"  Rows removed : {rows_before - rows_after}  ({(rows_before - rows_after)/rows_before*100:.1f}% of data)")
print(f"\nSegment breakdown after filtering:")
print(df_copy["segment"].value_counts().to_string())
```

## OLS

```{python}
#| label: ols_v1

import statsmodels.api as sm
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OLS Setup — Dummy encode all categoricals from existing train/test split
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

DUMMY_COLS = ['PropTypeDescription', 'SpecificPropTypeDescription',
              'NbhdCode2', 'Main_StyleDesc', 'segment']

train_ols = train.copy()
test_ols  = test.copy()

for col in DUMMY_COLS:
    if col in train_ols.columns:
        train_dummies = pd.get_dummies(train_ols[col], prefix=col, drop_first=True, dtype=int)
        test_dummies  = pd.get_dummies(test_ols[col],  prefix=col, drop_first=True, dtype=int)
        test_dummies  = test_dummies.reindex(columns=train_dummies.columns, fill_value=0)
        train_ols = pd.concat([train_ols.drop(columns=col), train_dummies], axis=1)
        test_ols  = pd.concat([test_ols.drop(columns=col),  test_dummies],  axis=1)

train_ols = train_ols.fillna(0)
test_ols  = test_ols.fillna(0)

EXCLUDE      = ["ln_Trended_Price"]
X_train_ols  = train_ols.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore")
X_test_ols   = test_ols.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore")
X_test_ols   = X_test_ols.reindex(columns=X_train_ols.columns, fill_value=0)
y_train_ols  = train["ln_Trended_Price"]
y_test_ols   = test["ln_Trended_Price"]

print(f"OLS feature matrix: {X_train_ols.shape[0]} rows | {X_train_ols.shape[1]} predictors")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OLS v1 — Base OLS, No Interactions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
X_train_ols_const = sm.add_constant(X_train_ols)
X_test_ols_const  = sm.add_constant(X_test_ols).reindex(
                        columns=X_train_ols_const.columns, fill_value=0)

ols_v1 = sm.OLS(y_train_ols, X_train_ols_const).fit()

y_pred_ols_v1_train = ols_v1.predict(X_train_ols_const)
y_pred_ols_v1_test  = ols_v1.predict(X_test_ols_const)
resid_ols_v1        = y_train_ols.values - y_pred_ols_v1_train.values

ss_res           = ((y_test_ols.values - y_pred_ols_v1_test.values) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot           = ((y_test_ols.values - y_test_ols.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_ols_v1   = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_ols_v1  = r2_score(y_train_ols, y_pred_ols_v1_train)

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("  OLS v1 — Base Model")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Train R²       : {r2_train_ols_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Test  R²       : {r2_test_ols_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap : {r2_train_ols_v1 - r2_test_ols_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  AIC            : {ols_v1.aic:.2f}")
print(f"  BIC            : {ols_v1.bic:.2f}")
print("=" * 50)

# ── Assumption tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw_v1 = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_ols_v1)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(resid_ols_v1, X_train_ols_const)

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_ols_v1).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_ols_v1).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_ols_v1.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw_v1:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Top significant coefficients ──────────────────────────────────────────────
coef_df_ols_v1 = pd.DataFrame({
    'coefficient': ols_v1.params,
    'p_value'    : ols_v1.pvalues,
    'std_err'    : ols_v1.bse
}).drop('const', errors='ignore')

coef_df_ols_v1 = coef_df_ols_v1[coef_df_ols_v1['p_value'] < 0.05].sort_values(
    'coefficient', key=abs, ascending=False)

print(f"\nSignificant coefficients (p < 0.05): {len(coef_df_ols_v1)}")
print(coef_df_ols_v1.head(20).to_string())

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_ols_v1_train, resid_ols_v1, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

(osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid_ols_v1, dist="norm")
axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

sqrt_abs_resid = np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_ols_v1))
axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_ols_v1_train, sqrt_abs_resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

seg_col_ols = [c for c in X_train_ols.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
if seg_col_ols:
    seg_labels_ols = pd.Series("Other", index=train_ols.index)
    seg_labels_ols[X_train_ols[seg_col_ols[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
else:
    seg_labels_ols = pd.Series("All", index=train_ols.index)

colors = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
for seg, col in colors.items():
    mask = seg_labels_ols == seg
    if mask.any():
        axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_ols_v1_train[mask], resid_ols_v1[mask],
                          alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,1].hist(resid_ols_v1, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

axes[1,2].scatter(y_test_ols, y_pred_ols_v1_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
axes[1,2].plot([y_test_ols.min(), y_test_ols.max()],
               [y_test_ols.min(), y_test_ols.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

plt.suptitle("OLS v1 — Base Model Full Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## PCR

```{python}
#| label: pcr_v1

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PCR helper function — reused by both v1 and v2
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def run_pcr(X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, label, max_components=None):
    # ── Scale ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    scaler         = StandardScaler()
    X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
    X_test_scaled  = scaler.transform(X_test)

    # ── PCA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    max_comp     = min(X_train_scaled.shape) if max_components is None else max_components
    pca_full     = PCA(n_components=max_comp, random_state=2026)
    Z_train_full = pca_full.fit_transform(X_train_scaled)
    Z_test_full  = pca_full.transform(X_test_scaled)

    # ── Variance summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    cum_var = np.cumsum(pca_full.explained_variance_ratio_)
    n_90    = np.searchsorted(cum_var, 0.90) + 1
    n_95    = np.searchsorted(cum_var, 0.95) + 1
    n_99    = np.searchsorted(cum_var, 0.99) + 1
    print(f"  Components for 90% variance : {n_90}")
    print(f"  Components for 95% variance : {n_95}")
    print(f"  Components for 99% variance : {n_99}")

    # ── Select components at 90% variance threshold ───────────────────────────
    best_n = n_90
    print(f"  Selected n_components (90%) : {best_n}")

    # ── Final model ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    Z_train  = Z_train_full[:, :best_n]
    Z_test   = Z_test_full[:, :best_n]
    lr_final = LinearRegression()
    lr_final.fit(Z_train, y_train)

    y_pred_train = lr_final.predict(Z_train)
    y_pred_test  = lr_final.predict(Z_test)
    resid        = y_train.values - y_pred_train

    ss_res   = ((y_test.values - y_pred_test) ** 2).sum()
    ss_tot   = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    r2_test  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
    r2_train = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_train)

    # ── Print results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n" + "=" * 55)
    print(f"  {label}")
    print("=" * 55)
    print(f"  Best n_components  : {best_n}")
    print(f"  Train R²           : {r2_train:.4f}")
    print(f"  Test  R²           : {r2_test:.4f}")
    print(f"  Train-Test gap     : {r2_train - r2_test:.4f}")
    print("=" * 55)

    # ── Assumption tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid)
    try:
        _, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
            resid, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(resid)), Z_train[:, :10]]))
        bp_result = f"{bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})"
    except Exception:
        bp_result = "Could not compute"

    print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid).skew():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid).kurt():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual std          : {resid.std():.4f}")
    print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
    print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_result}")

    # ── Scree plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    ax.plot(range(1, len(cum_var) + 1), cum_var, marker='o', markersize=3, color="#2980b9")
    ax.axhline(0.90, color="orange", linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, label="90%")
    ax.axhline(0.95, color="red",    linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, label="95%")
    ax.axvline(best_n, color="green", linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, label=f"Selected n={best_n}")
    ax.set_title("Cumulative Explained Variance")
    ax.set_xlabel("Number of Components")
    ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative Variance")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Component Selection", fontsize=13)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    seg_col = [c for c in X_train.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
    if seg_col:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("Other", index=X_train.index)
        seg_labels[X_train[seg_col[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
    else:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("All", index=X_train.index)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

    axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_train, resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
    axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

    (osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid, dist="norm")
    axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
    axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
    axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

    axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_train, np.sqrt(np.abs(resid)),
                      alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
    axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
    axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

    colors_map = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
    for seg, col in colors_map.items():
        mask = seg_labels == seg
        if mask.any():
            axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_train[mask], resid[mask],
                              alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
    axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
    axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,0].legend()

    axes[1,1].hist(resid, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
    axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
    axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

    axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
    axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
                   [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
    axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
    axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Full Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return y_pred_train, y_pred_test, resid, best_n, r2_train, r2_test, cum_var

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PCR v1 — Baseline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("=" * 55)
print("  PCR v1 — Baseline")
print("=" * 55)

(y_pred_pcr_v1_train, y_pred_pcr_v1_test,
 resid_pcr_v1, best_n_v1,
 r2_train_pcr_v1, r2_test_pcr_v1,
 cum_var_v1) = run_pcr(
    X_train_ols, X_test_ols,
    y_train_ols, y_test_ols,
    label="PCR v1 — Baseline"
)
```

```{python}
#| label: pcr_v2

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PCR v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Build interaction terms ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
nbhd_dummies_pcr     = [c for c in X_train_ols.columns if c.startswith("NbhdCode2_")]
seg_dummies_pcr      = [c for c in X_train_ols.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
interact_dummies_pcr = nbhd_dummies_pcr + seg_dummies_pcr
numeric_preds_pcr    = [c for c in X_train_ols.columns if c not in interact_dummies_pcr]

print(f"Building PCR v2 interactions:")
print(f"  NbhdCode2 dummies  : {len(nbhd_dummies_pcr)}")
print(f"  Segment dummies    : {len(seg_dummies_pcr)}")
print(f"  Numeric predictors : {len(numeric_preds_pcr)}")
print(f"  Total interactions : {len(interact_dummies_pcr) * len(numeric_preds_pcr)}")

train_interactions_pcr = {}
test_interactions_pcr  = {}

for dummy_col in interact_dummies_pcr:
    for num_col in numeric_preds_pcr:
        col_name = f"{dummy_col}_x_{num_col}".replace(" ", "_")
        train_interactions_pcr[col_name] = X_train_ols[dummy_col] * X_train_ols[num_col]
        test_interactions_pcr[col_name]  = X_test_ols[dummy_col]  * X_test_ols[num_col]

X_train_pcr_v2 = pd.concat([
    X_train_ols,
    pd.DataFrame(train_interactions_pcr, index=X_train_ols.index)
], axis=1)
X_test_pcr_v2 = pd.concat([
    X_test_ols,
    pd.DataFrame(test_interactions_pcr, index=X_test_ols.index)
], axis=1)
X_test_pcr_v2 = X_test_pcr_v2.reindex(columns=X_train_pcr_v2.columns, fill_value=0)

# ── Drop zero variance columns ────────────────────────────────────────────────
zero_var       = X_train_pcr_v2.var() == 0
X_train_pcr_v2 = X_train_pcr_v2.loc[:, ~zero_var]
X_test_pcr_v2  = X_test_pcr_v2.reindex(columns=X_train_pcr_v2.columns, fill_value=0)

print(f"  Final predictor count: {X_train_pcr_v2.shape[1]}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n" + "=" * 55)
print("  PCR v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions")
print("=" * 55)

(y_pred_pcr_v2_train, y_pred_pcr_v2_test,
 resid_pcr_v2, best_n_v2,
 r2_train_pcr_v2, r2_test_pcr_v2,
 cum_var_v2) = run_pcr(
    X_train_pcr_v2, X_test_pcr_v2,
    y_train_ols, y_test_ols,
    label="PCR v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions"
)

# ── Final comparison ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n" + "=" * 55)
print("  PCR Summary")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"  {'Model':<45} {'Test R²':>8}  {'Gap':>8}")
print(f"  {'-'*61}")

print(f"  {'PCR v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions':<45} {r2_test_pcr_v2:>8.4f}  {r2_train_pcr_v2 - r2_test_pcr_v2:>8.4f}")
```

## PLS

```{python}
#| label: pls_v1

from sklearn.cross_decomposition import PLSRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PLS helper function — reused by both v1 and v2
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def run_pls(X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, label, max_components=30):
    # ── Scale ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    scaler         = StandardScaler()
    X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
    X_test_scaled  = scaler.transform(X_test)

    # ── Cross-validated component selection ───────────────────────────────────
    kf         = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=2026)
    candidates = list(range(1, max_components + 1))
    cv_r2      = []

    print(f"  Running 5-fold CV over {len(candidates)} component counts...")
    for n in candidates:
        fold_r2 = []
        for tr_idx, val_idx in kf.split(X_train_scaled):
            pls = PLSRegression(n_components=n, max_iter=500)
            pls.fit(X_train_scaled[tr_idx], y_train.iloc[tr_idx])
            fold_r2.append(r2_score(y_train.iloc[val_idx],
                                    pls.predict(X_train_scaled[val_idx]).flatten()))
        cv_r2.append(np.mean(fold_r2))

    best_n  = candidates[np.argmax(cv_r2)]
    best_cv = max(cv_r2)
    print(f"  Best n_components (CV) : {best_n}  (CV R² = {best_cv:.4f})")

    # ── Fit final model ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    pls_final = PLSRegression(n_components=best_n, max_iter=500)
    pls_final.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train)

    y_pred_train = pls_final.predict(X_train_scaled).flatten()
    y_pred_test  = pls_final.predict(X_test_scaled).flatten()
    resid        = y_train.values - y_pred_train

    ss_res   = ((y_test.values - y_pred_test) ** 2).sum()
    ss_tot   = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    r2_test  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
    r2_train = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_train)

    # ── Print results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n" + "=" * 55)
    print(f"  {label}")
    print("=" * 55)
    print(f"  Best n_components  : {best_n}")
    print(f"  Train R²           : {r2_train:.4f}")
    print(f"  Test  R²           : {r2_test:.4f}")
    print(f"  Train-Test gap     : {r2_train - r2_test:.4f}")
    print("=" * 55)

    # ── Assumption tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid)
    try:
        _, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
            resid, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(resid)), X_train_scaled[:, :10]]))
        bp_result = f"{bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})"
    except Exception:
        bp_result = "Could not compute"

    print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid).skew():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid).kurt():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual std          : {resid.std():.4f}")
    print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
    print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_result}")

    # ── CV R² plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    ax.plot(candidates, cv_r2, marker='o', markersize=4, color="#9b59b6")
    ax.axvline(best_n, color="green", linestyle="--",
               label=f"Best n={best_n} (R²={best_cv:.4f})")
    ax.set_title("CV R² by Number of PLS Components")
    ax.set_xlabel("Number of Components")
    ax.set_ylabel("5-Fold CV R²")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Component Selection", fontsize=13)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    seg_col = [c for c in X_train.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
    if seg_col:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("Other", index=X_train.index)
        seg_labels[X_train[seg_col[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
    else:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("All", index=X_train.index)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

    axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_train, resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
    axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

    (osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid, dist="norm")
    axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
    axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
    axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

    axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_train, np.sqrt(np.abs(resid)),
                      alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
    axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
    axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

    colors_map = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
    for seg, col in colors_map.items():
        mask = seg_labels == seg
        if mask.any():
            axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_train[mask], resid[mask],
                              alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
    axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
    axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,0].legend()

    axes[1,1].hist(resid, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
    axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
    axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

    axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
    axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
                   [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
    axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
    axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Full Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return y_pred_train, y_pred_test, resid, best_n, r2_train, r2_test, cv_r2, candidates

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PLS v1 — Baseline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("=" * 55)
print("  PLS v1 — Baseline")
print("=" * 55)

(y_pred_pls_v1_train, y_pred_pls_v1_test,
 resid_pls_v1, best_n_pls_v1,
 r2_train_pls_v1, r2_test_pls_v1,
 cv_r2_pls_v1, candidates_pls_v1) = run_pls(
    X_train_ols, X_test_ols,
    y_train_ols, y_test_ols,
    label="PLS v1 — Baseline"
)

```

## ElasticNet

```{python}
#| label: elasticnet_v1

from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ElasticNet helper function — reused by both v1 and v2
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def run_elasticnet(X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, label):
    # ── Scale ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    scaler         = StandardScaler()
    X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
    X_test_scaled  = scaler.transform(X_test)

    # ── Fit ElasticNetCV ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    enet = ElasticNetCV(
        l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
        alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
        cv           = 5,
        max_iter     = 50000,
        tol          = 1e-3,
        n_jobs       = -1,
        random_state = 2026
    )
    enet.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train)

    y_pred_train = enet.predict(X_train_scaled)
    y_pred_test  = enet.predict(X_test_scaled)
    resid        = y_train.values - y_pred_train

    nonzero  = (enet.coef_ != 0).sum()
    zeroed   = (enet.coef_ == 0).sum()
    ss_res   = ((y_test.values - y_pred_test) ** 2).sum()
    ss_tot   = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    r2_test  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
    r2_train = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_train)

    # ── Print results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n" + "=" * 55)
    print(f"  {label}")
    print("=" * 55)
    print(f"  Alpha          : {enet.alpha_:.6f}")
    print(f"  L1 ratio       : {enet.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
    print(f"  Non-zero       : {nonzero} / {len(enet.coef_)}  ({zeroed} zeroed out)")
    print(f"  Train R²       : {r2_train:.4f}")
    print(f"  Test  R²       : {r2_test:.4f}")
    print(f"  Train-Test gap : {r2_train - r2_test:.4f}")
    print("=" * 55)

    # ── Assumption tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid)
    try:
        _, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
            resid, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(resid)), X_train_scaled[:, :10]]))
        bp_result = f"{bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})"
    except Exception:
        bp_result = "Could not compute"

    print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid).skew():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid).kurt():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual std          : {resid.std():.4f}")
    print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
    print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_result}")

    # ── Top surviving coefficients ────────────────────────────────────────────
    coef_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'feature'    : X_train.columns,
        'coefficient': enet.coef_
    }).query('coefficient != 0').sort_values('coefficient', key=abs, ascending=False)

    print(f"\nTop 20 surviving coefficients (of {nonzero} non-zero):")
    print(coef_df.head(20).to_string())

    # ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    seg_col = [c for c in X_train.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
    if seg_col:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("Other", index=X_train.index)
        seg_labels[X_train[seg_col[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
    else:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("All", index=X_train.index)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

    axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_train, resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
    axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

    (osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid, dist="norm")
    axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
    axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
    axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

    axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_train, np.sqrt(np.abs(resid)),
                      alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
    axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
    axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

    colors_map = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
    for seg, col in colors_map.items():
        mask = seg_labels == seg
        if mask.any():
            axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_train[mask], resid[mask],
                              alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
    axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
    axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,0].legend()

    axes[1,1].hist(resid, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
    axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
    axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

    axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
    axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
                   [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
    axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
    axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Full Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return y_pred_train, y_pred_test, resid, r2_train, r2_test, enet, coef_df

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ElasticNet v1 — Baseline
```

## Quantile Regression

```{python}
#| label: quantile_v1

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Quantile Regression helper function — reused by both v1 and v2
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def run_quantile(X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, label, quantiles=[0.10, 0.50, 0.90]):
    """
    Fits quantile regression at each specified quantile.
    Primary model for R² reporting is the median (q=0.50).
    """
    # ── Build formula-ready dataframes ────────────────────────────────────────
    # statsmodels QuantReg needs a matrix interface — use sm.add_constant
    X_train_const = sm.add_constant(X_train.values)
    X_test_const  = sm.add_constant(X_test.values)

    # Align constant column in test
    if X_train_const.shape[1] != X_test_const.shape[1]:
        X_test_const = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X_test)), X_test.values])

    results   = {}
    models    = {}

    for q in quantiles:
        print(f"  Fitting quantile q={q}...")
        qr = sm.QuantReg(y_train.values, X_train_const)
        res = qr.fit(q=q, max_iter=1000)
        models[q]  = res

        y_pred_train = res.predict(X_train_const)
        y_pred_test  = res.predict(X_test_const)

        ss_res  = ((y_test.values - y_pred_test) ** 2).sum()
        ss_tot  = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
        r2_test = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
        r2_train = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_train)

        results[q] = {
            'y_pred_train': y_pred_train,
            'y_pred_test' : y_pred_test,
            'r2_train'    : r2_train,
            'r2_test'     : r2_test,
            'resid'       : y_train.values - y_pred_train
        }

    # ── Print results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n" + "=" * 55)
    print(f"  {label}")
    print("=" * 55)
    for q in quantiles:
        r = results[q]
        print(f"  q={q:.2f}  Train R²: {r['r2_train']:.4f}  "
              f"Test R²: {r['r2_test']:.4f}  "
              f"Gap: {r['r2_train'] - r['r2_test']:.4f}")
    print("=" * 55)

    # ── Assumption tests on median model ─────────────────────────────────────
    resid_med = results[0.50]['resid']
    dw        = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_med)
    try:
        _, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
            resid_med, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(resid_med)),
                                        X_train_const[:, 1:11]]))
        bp_result = f"{bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})"
    except Exception:
        bp_result = "Could not compute"

    print(f"\n  Median model (q=0.50) assumption tests:")
    print(f"  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_med).skew():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_med).kurt():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_med.std():.4f}")
    print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
    print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_result}")

    # ── Top coefficients for median model ─────────────────────────────────────
    coef_names = ['const'] + list(X_train.columns)
    coef_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'feature'    : coef_names,
        'coefficient': models[0.50].params,
        'p_value'    : models[0.50].pvalues
    }).query('feature != "const"')
    coef_df = coef_df[coef_df['p_value'] < 0.05].sort_values(
        'coefficient', key=abs, ascending=False)

    print(f"\n  Significant coefficients at q=0.50 (p < 0.05): {len(coef_df)}")
    print(coef_df.head(20).to_string())

    # ── Segment labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    seg_col = [c for c in X_train.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
    if seg_col:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("Other", index=X_train.index)
        seg_labels[X_train[seg_col[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
    else:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("All", index=X_train.index)

    # ── Diagnostic plots for median model ────────────────────────────────────
    y_pred_med_train = results[0.50]['y_pred_train']
    y_pred_med_test  = results[0.50]['y_pred_test']

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

    axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_med_train, resid_med, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted (q=0.50)")
    axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

    (osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid_med, dist="norm")
    axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
    axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot (q=0.50)")
    axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

    axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_med_train, np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_med)),
                      alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
    axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (q=0.50)")
    axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

    colors_map = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
    for seg, col in colors_map.items():
        mask = seg_labels == seg
        if mask.any():
            axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_med_train[mask], resid_med[mask],
                              alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
    axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment (q=0.50)")
    axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,0].legend()

    axes[1,1].hist(resid_med, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
    axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution (q=0.50)")
    axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

    axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_med_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
    axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
                   [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted — q=0.50 (Test Set)")
    axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
    axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Median Model Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # ── Quantile band plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    sort_idx = np.argsort(y_test.values)
    y_test_sorted = y_test.values[sort_idx]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 5))
    ax.plot(y_test_sorted,
            results[0.50]['y_pred_test'][sort_idx],
            color="#2980b9", label="q=0.50 (median)", linewidth=1.5)
    ax.fill_between(
        y_test_sorted,
        results[0.10]['y_pred_test'][sort_idx],
        results[0.90]['y_pred_test'][sort_idx],
        alpha=0.2, color="#2980b9", label="q=0.10 — q=0.90 band"
    )
    ax.plot(y_test_sorted, y_test_sorted,
            color="red", linestyle="--", label="Perfect prediction")
    ax.set_title(f"{label} — Prediction Intervals (Test Set)")
    ax.set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return results, models

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Quantile Regression v1 — Baseline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("=" * 55)
print("  Quantile Regression v1 — Baseline")
print("=" * 55)

results_qr_v1, models_qr_v1 = run_quantile(
    X_train_ols, X_test_ols,
    y_train_ols, y_test_ols,

)
```

## WLS

```{python}
#| label: wls_v1

from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WLS helper function — reused by both v1 and v2
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def run_wls(X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, label):
    X_train_const = sm.add_constant(X_train.values)
    X_test_const  = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X_test)), X_test.values])

    # ── Step 1: Use only base predictors for weight estimation ────────────────
    # For stability, always estimate variance structure from base X_train_ols
    # regardless of how many predictors the full model has
    print(f"  Step 1: Estimating variance structure from base predictors...")
    X_base_const   = sm.add_constant(X_train_ols.values)
    ols_for_weights = sm.OLS(y_train.values, X_base_const).fit()
    fitted_for_weights = ols_for_weights.predict(X_base_const)
    resid_for_weights  = y_train.values - fitted_for_weights

    # ── Step 2: Model log variance vs fitted values ───────────────────────────
    log_resid_sq   = np.log(resid_for_weights ** 2 + 1e-10)
    variance_model = sm.OLS(
        log_resid_sq,
        sm.add_constant(fitted_for_weights)
    ).fit()

    # ── Compute weights for train using base fitted values ────────────────────
    log_var_train  = variance_model.predict(sm.add_constant(fitted_for_weights))

    # For test — use base OLS to get fitted values for weight estimation
    X_base_test_const = sm.add_constant(X_test_ols.values)
    fitted_test_base  = ols_for_weights.predict(X_base_test_const)
    log_var_test      = variance_model.predict(sm.add_constant(fitted_test_base))

    weights_train  = 1.0 / (np.exp(log_var_train) + 1e-10)
    weights_test   = 1.0 / (np.exp(log_var_test)  + 1e-10)
    weights_train  = weights_train / weights_train.mean()
    weights_test   = weights_test  / weights_test.mean()

    # ── Step 3: Fit WLS with full feature set but stable weights ─────────────
    print(f"  Step 2: Fitting WLS ({X_train_const.shape[1]} predictors)...")
    wls_model     = sm.WLS(y_train.values, X_train_const, weights=weights_train).fit()

    y_pred_train  = wls_model.predict(X_train_const)
    y_pred_test   = wls_model.predict(X_test_const)
    resid         = y_train.values - y_pred_train

    ss_res   = ((y_test.values - y_pred_test) ** 2).sum()
    ss_tot   = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    r2_test  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
    r2_train = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_train)

    # ── Print results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n" + "=" * 55)
    print(f"  {label}")
    print("=" * 55)
    print(f"  Train R²       : {r2_train:.4f}")
    print(f"  Test  R²       : {r2_test:.4f}")
    print(f"  Train-Test gap : {r2_train - r2_test:.4f}")
    print(f"  AIC            : {wls_model.aic:.2f}")
    print(f"  BIC            : {wls_model.bic:.2f}")
    print("=" * 55)

    # ── Assumption tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid)
    try:
        _, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
            resid, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(resid)),
                                    X_train_const[:, 1:11]]))
        bp_result = f"{bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})"
    except Exception:
        bp_result = "Could not compute"

    print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid).skew():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid).kurt():.3f}")
    print(f"  Residual std          : {resid.std():.4f}")
    print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
    print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_result}")

    # ── Top significant coefficients ──────────────────────────────────────────
    coef_names = ['const'] + list(X_train.columns)
    coef_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'feature'    : coef_names,
        'coefficient': wls_model.params,
        'p_value'    : wls_model.pvalues
    }).query('feature != "const"')
    coef_df = coef_df[coef_df['p_value'] < 0.05].sort_values(
        'coefficient', key=abs, ascending=False)

    print(f"\n  Significant coefficients (p < 0.05): {len(coef_df)}")
    print(coef_df.head(20).to_string())

    # ── Weight distribution plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    ax.scatter(fitted_for_weights, weights_train, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    ax.set_title("WLS Weights vs Fitted Values")
    ax.set_xlabel("Fitted Values (base OLS)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Weight")
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Weight Structure", fontsize=13)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    seg_col = [c for c in X_train.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
    if seg_col:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("Other", index=X_train.index)
        seg_labels[X_train[seg_col[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
    else:
        seg_labels = pd.Series("All", index=X_train.index)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

    axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_train, resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
    axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

    (osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid, dist="norm")
    axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
    axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
    axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
    axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

    axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_train, np.sqrt(np.abs(resid)),
                      alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
    axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
    axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

    colors_map = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
    for seg, col in colors_map.items():
        mask = seg_labels == seg
        if mask.any():
            axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_train[mask], resid[mask],
                              alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
    axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
    axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,0].legend()

    axes[1,1].hist(resid, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
    axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
    axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

    axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
    axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
                   [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
    axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
    axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
    axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

    plt.suptitle(f"{label} — Full Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return y_pred_train, y_pred_test, resid, r2_train, r2_test, wls_model, coef_df

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WLS v1 — Baseline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("=" * 55)
print("  WLS v1 — Baseline")
print("=" * 55)

(y_pred_wls_v1_train, y_pred_wls_v1_test,
 resid_wls_v1, r2_train_wls_v1,
 r2_test_wls_v1, wls_model_v1,
 coef_df_wls_v1) = run_wls(
    X_train_ols, X_test_ols,
    y_train_ols, y_test_ols,
    label="WLS v1 — Baseline"
)
```

```{python}
#| label: wls_v2

from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WLS v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions (Regularized WLS via ElasticNet)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Uses variance-based weights from base OLS (same as v1) but fits the final
# model with weighted ElasticNetCV to handle the high-dimensional interaction
# matrix without multicollinearity issues

print("=" * 55)
print("  WLS v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions")
print("=" * 55)

# ── Step 1: Estimate variance structure from base OLS ─────────────────────────
print("  Step 1: Estimating variance structure from base predictors...")
X_base_const        = sm.add_constant(X_train_ols.values)
X_base_test_const   = sm.add_constant(X_test_ols.values)
ols_for_weights     = sm.OLS(y_train_ols.values, X_base_const).fit()
fitted_for_weights  = ols_for_weights.predict(X_base_const)
resid_for_weights   = y_train_ols.values - fitted_for_weights

log_resid_sq        = np.log(resid_for_weights ** 2 + 1e-10)
variance_model      = sm.OLS(
    log_resid_sq,
    sm.add_constant(fitted_for_weights)
).fit()

fitted_test_base    = ols_for_weights.predict(X_base_test_const)
log_var_train       = variance_model.predict(sm.add_constant(fitted_for_weights))
log_var_test        = variance_model.predict(sm.add_constant(fitted_test_base))

weights_train_v2    = 1.0 / (np.exp(log_var_train) + 1e-10)
weights_test_v2     = 1.0 / (np.exp(log_var_test)  + 1e-10)
weights_train_v2    = weights_train_v2 / weights_train_v2.mean()
weights_test_v2     = weights_test_v2  / weights_test_v2.mean()

print(f"  Weights computed — mean: {weights_train_v2.mean():.4f}  "
      f"std: {weights_train_v2.std():.4f}  "
      f"range: [{weights_train_v2.min():.4f}, {weights_train_v2.max():.4f}]")

# ── Step 2: Scale interaction feature matrix ──────────────────────────────────
print(f"  Step 2: Scaling feature matrix ({X_train_pcr_v2.shape[1]} predictors)...")
scaler_wls_v2         = StandardScaler()
X_train_wls_v2_scaled = scaler_wls_v2.fit_transform(X_train_pcr_v2.values)
X_test_wls_v2_scaled  = scaler_wls_v2.transform(X_test_pcr_v2.values)

# ── Step 3: Weighted ElasticNetCV ─────────────────────────────────────────────
print("  Step 3: Fitting weighted ElasticNetCV...")
enet_wls_v2 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 50000,
    tol          = 1e-3,
    n_jobs       = -1,
    random_state = 2026
)
enet_wls_v2.fit(X_train_wls_v2_scaled, y_train_ols,
                sample_weight=weights_train_v2)

y_pred_wls_v2_train = enet_wls_v2.predict(X_train_wls_v2_scaled)
y_pred_wls_v2_test  = enet_wls_v2.predict(X_test_wls_v2_scaled)
resid_wls_v2        = y_train_ols.values - y_pred_wls_v2_train

nonzero_v2 = (enet_wls_v2.coef_ != 0).sum()
zeroed_v2  = (enet_wls_v2.coef_ == 0).sum()

ss_res          = ((y_test_ols.values - y_pred_wls_v2_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot          = ((y_test_ols.values - y_test_ols.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_wls_v2  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_wls_v2 = r2_score(y_train_ols, y_pred_wls_v2_train)

# ── Print results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n" + "=" * 55)
print("  WLS v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"  Alpha          : {enet_wls_v2.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"  L1 ratio       : {enet_wls_v2.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
print(f"  Non-zero       : {nonzero_v2} / {len(enet_wls_v2.coef_)}  ({zeroed_v2} zeroed out)")
print(f"  Train R²       : {r2_train_wls_v2:.4f}")
print(f"  Test  R²       : {r2_test_wls_v2:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap : {r2_train_wls_v2 - r2_test_wls_v2:.4f}")
print("=" * 55)

# ── Assumption tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw_wls_v2 = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_wls_v2)
try:
    _, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
        resid_wls_v2,
        np.column_stack([np.ones(len(resid_wls_v2)),
                         X_train_wls_v2_scaled[:, :10]]))
    bp_result = f"{bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})"
except Exception:
    bp_result = "Could not compute"

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_wls_v2).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_wls_v2).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_wls_v2.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw_wls_v2:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_result}")

# ── Top surviving coefficients ────────────────────────────────────────────────
coef_df_wls_v2 = pd.DataFrame({
    'feature'    : X_train_pcr_v2.columns,
    'coefficient': enet_wls_v2.coef_
}).query('coefficient != 0').sort_values('coefficient', key=abs, ascending=False)

print(f"\nTop 20 surviving coefficients (of {nonzero_v2} non-zero):")
print(coef_df_wls_v2.head(20).to_string())

# ── Weight distribution plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
ax.scatter(fitted_for_weights, weights_train_v2,
           alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
ax.set_title("WLS v2 Weights vs Fitted Values (from base OLS)")
ax.set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
ax.set_ylabel("Weight")
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.suptitle("WLS v2 — Weight Structure", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seg_col = [c for c in X_train_pcr_v2.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
if seg_col:
    seg_labels_wls_v2 = pd.Series("Other", index=X_train_pcr_v2.index)
    seg_labels_wls_v2[X_train_pcr_v2[seg_col[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
else:
    seg_labels_wls_v2 = pd.Series("All", index=X_train_pcr_v2.index)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_wls_v2_train, resid_wls_v2,
                  alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

(osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid_wls_v2, dist="norm")
axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_wls_v2_train, np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_wls_v2)),
                  alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

colors_map = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
for seg, col in colors_map.items():
    mask = seg_labels_wls_v2 == seg
    if mask.any():
        axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_wls_v2_train[mask], resid_wls_v2[mask],
                          alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,1].hist(resid_wls_v2, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

axes[1,2].scatter(y_test_ols, y_pred_wls_v2_test,
                  alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
axes[1,2].plot([y_test_ols.min(), y_test_ols.max()],
               [y_test_ols.min(), y_test_ols.max()],
               color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

plt.suptitle("WLS v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions — Full Diagnostics",
             fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Final comparison ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n" + "=" * 55)
print("  WLS Summary")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"  {'Model':<45} {'Test R²':>8}  {'Gap':>8}")
print(f"  {'-'*61}")
print(f"  {'WLS v1 — Baseline':<45} {r2_test_wls_v1:>8.4f}  {r2_train_wls_v1 - r2_test_wls_v1:>8.4f}")
print(f"  {'WLS v2 — NbhdCode2 + Segment Interactions':<45} {r2_test_wls_v2:>8.4f}  {r2_train_wls_v2 - r2_test_wls_v2:>8.4f}")
print("=" * 55)
```

## GAM

```{python}
#| label: gam_v1

from pygam import LinearGAM, s
from functools import reduce
import operator
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GAM v1 — Two-Stage Hybrid (ElasticNet + Splines)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Dummy encode categoricals from existing train/test split ──────────────────
DUMMY_COLS = ['PropTypeDescription', 'SpecificPropTypeDescription',
              'NbhdCode2', 'Main_StyleDesc', 'segment']

train_v1 = train.copy()
test_v1  = test.copy()

for col in DUMMY_COLS:
    if col in train_v1.columns:
        # Fit dummies on train, apply same columns to test
        train_dummies = pd.get_dummies(train_v1[col], prefix=col, drop_first=True, dtype=int)
        test_dummies  = pd.get_dummies(test_v1[col],  prefix=col, drop_first=True, dtype=int)
        # Align test to train columns
        test_dummies  = test_dummies.reindex(columns=train_dummies.columns, fill_value=0)
        train_v1 = pd.concat([train_v1.drop(columns=col), train_dummies], axis=1)
        test_v1  = pd.concat([test_v1.drop(columns=col),  test_dummies],  axis=1)

train_v1 = train_v1.fillna(0)
test_v1  = test_v1.fillna(0)

EXCLUDE    = ["ln_Trended_Price"]
X_train_v1 = train_v1.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore")
X_test_v1  = test_v1.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore")
X_test_v1  = X_test_v1.reindex(columns=X_train_v1.columns, fill_value=0)
y_train_v1 = train["ln_Trended_Price"]
y_test_v1  = test["ln_Trended_Price"]

print(f"Train : {X_train_v1.shape[0]} rows | {X_train_v1.shape[1]} predictors")
print(f"Test  : {X_test_v1.shape[0]} rows")

# ── Define spline vs linear columns ──────────────────────────────────────────
SPLINE_COLS = ["ln_GLA", "EffYearBuilt_Weighted", "Quality_Weighted",
               "AsinH_Acreage", "AsinH_Land_Value", "AsinH_Total_Value"]
spline_cols = [c for c in SPLINE_COLS if c in X_train_v1.columns]
linear_cols = [c for c in X_train_v1.columns if c not in spline_cols]

print(f"\nStage 1 (ElasticNet) : {len(linear_cols)} predictors")
print(f"Stage 2 (GAM splines): {len(spline_cols)} — {spline_cols}")

X_train_linear_v1 = X_train_v1[linear_cols].values
X_test_linear_v1  = X_test_v1[linear_cols].values
X_train_spline_v1 = X_train_v1[spline_cols].values
X_test_spline_v1  = X_test_v1[spline_cols].values

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1 — ElasticNet
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
scaler_v1             = StandardScaler()
X_train_lin_v1_scaled = scaler_v1.fit_transform(X_train_linear_v1)
X_test_lin_v1_scaled  = scaler_v1.transform(X_test_linear_v1)

enet_v1 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 50000,
    tol          = 1e-3,
    n_jobs       = -1,
    random_state = 2026
)
enet_v1.fit(X_train_lin_v1_scaled, y_train_v1)

y_stage1_v1_train = enet_v1.predict(X_train_lin_v1_scaled)
y_stage1_v1_test  = enet_v1.predict(X_test_lin_v1_scaled)
resid_stage1_v1   = y_train_v1.values - y_stage1_v1_train

nonzero_v1 = (enet_v1.coef_ != 0).sum()
print(f"\nStage 1 complete:")
print(f"  Alpha    : {enet_v1.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"  L1 ratio : {enet_v1.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
print(f"  Non-zero : {nonzero_v1} / {len(enet_v1.coef_)}  ({len(enet_v1.coef_) - nonzero_v1} zeroed out)")
print(f"  Train R² : {r2_score(y_train_v1, y_stage1_v1_train):.4f}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2 — GAM splines on Stage 1 residuals
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
spline_idx = list(range(len(spline_cols)))
gam_terms  = reduce(operator.add, [s(i, n_splines=20) for i in spline_idx])

gam_v1 = LinearGAM(gam_terms)
gam_v1.gridsearch(
    X_train_spline_v1, resid_stage1_v1,
    lam=np.logspace(0, 8, 60),  # ← floor raised to 1, ceiling to 1e8, more points
    progress=False
)

best_lam_v1 = np.unique([round(float(l[0]), 4) for l in gam_v1.lam])
print(f"\nStage 2 complete:")
print(f"  Best lambda : {best_lam_v1}")
print(f"  GCV Score   : {gam_v1.statistics_['GCV']:.6f}")

# ── Combined predictions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_spline_v1_train = gam_v1.predict(X_train_spline_v1)
y_spline_v1_test  = gam_v1.predict(X_test_spline_v1)

y_pred_v1_train = y_stage1_v1_train + y_spline_v1_train
y_pred_v1_test  = y_stage1_v1_test  + y_spline_v1_test
resid_v1        = y_train_v1.values - y_pred_v1_train

ss_res      = ((y_test_v1.values - y_pred_v1_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot      = ((y_test_v1.values - y_test_v1.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_v1  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_v1 = r2_score(y_train_v1, y_pred_v1_train)

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("  GAM v1 — Two-Stage Hybrid")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Stage 1 Train R² (ElasticNet) : {r2_score(y_train_v1, y_stage1_v1_train):.4f}")
print(f"  Stage 2 correction added      : {r2_score(resid_stage1_v1, y_spline_v1_train):.4f} R² of residuals explained")
print(f"  Combined Train R²             : {r2_train_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Combined Test  R²             : {r2_test_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap                : {r2_train_v1 - r2_test_v1:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)

# ── Assumption tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_v1)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(resid_v1, sm.add_constant(X_train_lin_v1_scaled))

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_v1).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_v1).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_v1.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Partial dependence plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(spline_cols), figsize=(5 * len(spline_cols), 4))
for i, col in enumerate(spline_cols):
    XX = gam_v1.generate_X_grid(term=i)
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_v1.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX))
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_v1.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX, width=0.95)[1],
                 c="r", ls="--", alpha=0.5)
    axes[i].set_title(f"Spline: {col}")
    axes[i].set_xlabel(col)
    axes[i].set_ylabel("Nonlinear Correction")
plt.suptitle("GAM v1 — Partial Dependence of Spline Corrections", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_v1_train, resid_v1, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

(osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid_v1, dist="norm")
axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

sqrt_abs_resid_v1 = np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_v1))
axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_v1_train, sqrt_abs_resid_v1, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

seg_col_v1 = [c for c in X_train_v1.columns if c.startswith("segment_")]
if seg_col_v1:
    seg_labels_v1 = pd.Series("Other", index=train_v1.index)
    seg_labels_v1[X_train_v1[seg_col_v1[0]] == 1] = "Residential"
else:
    seg_labels_v1 = pd.Series("All", index=train_v1.index)

colors = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Other": "#f39c12", "All": "#2980b9"}
for seg, col in colors.items():
    mask = seg_labels_v1 == seg
    if mask.any():
        axes[1,0].scatter(y_pred_v1_train[mask], resid_v1[mask],
                          alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg)
axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,1].hist(resid_v1, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

axes[1,2].scatter(y_test_v1, y_pred_v1_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
axes[1,2].plot([y_test_v1.min(), y_test_v1.max()],
               [y_test_v1.min(), y_test_v1.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

plt.suptitle("GAM v1 — Two-Stage Hybrid Full Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```
